carry_out: temporary items dissolve; permanent gear remains in the run ledger

loot.narration: Describe what is found, where it was carried, and its condition before presenting the mechanical row.
loot.npc_inventory_policy: Not every NPC carries a full table. Use role, circumstances, clothing, pockets, and visible equipment to determine plausible finds.

defeat: eject; re-entry starts a fresh run from frozen baselines

floors.name: The Town Above the Well
floors.posture: residents watch the market and close ranks around the well
floors.motive: Keep trade moving and strangers away from the town's coordinated store of seals.
floors.law: Town-controlled sleep raises an alarm and brings an organized night patrol.
floors.terrain: Narrow lanes, market stalls, shuttered homes, and the well.
floors.tell: Identical copper clasps flash when residents close ranks.
floors.secret: The well route can be opened from the market's old waterwheel.
floors.hazard: A weighted well platform drops when its latch is released.

enemy.name: Town watch
enemy.trait: closed ranks: a second press in the same round, spent from a pool, matching the copper-clasp tell

floors.name: The Machine Works
floors.posture: cleaners route visitors toward the working lanes
floors.motive: Route contamination away from working equipment; accept proof of maintenance clearance.
floors.law: Slow cleaners classify unregistered visitors as contamination. Cut power to open a safe maintenance path.
floors.terrain: Conveyor lanes, metal gantries, steam vents, and a locked hatch.
floors.tell: A blue cable links the cleaners' armor to a stationary relay.
floors.secret: A service hatch bypasses the sorting line.
floors.hazard: A conveyor carries unsecured travelers toward a steam press.

enemy.name: Cleaner
enemy.trait: relay surge: the blue cable to the stationary relay is the tell for the piercing resistance and the surge pool

floors.name: The Three Dragons
floors.posture: territory representatives measure which approach the party chooses
floors.motive: Protect draconic dependents and redirect rivals away from its patron's stores.
floors.law: White, red, and black territories recognize bargains and trespasses separately.
floors.terrain: Three marked approaches surround a shared gallery and hoard passages.
floors.tell: Painted scales on supply crates reveal which territory supplied each guard.
floors.secret: A neutral tunnel reaches the lower route without crossing a nursery.
floors.hazard: A contested supply bridge has been rigged to collapse.

enemy.name: Lair outrider
enemy.trait: wing rush: painted territory scales are the tell for which lair's fire resistance an outrider carries

floors.name: The Sunless Sea
floors.posture: the ferryman holds the lit landing while the water moves below
floors.motive: Recover navigation lamps while keeping the drowned away from the landing.
floors.law: Light reveals solid footholds; entering unlit water exposes travelers to pursuit.
floors.terrain: Drowned decks, broken piers, dark water, and narrow lit islands.
floors.tell: Salt dries in handprints above the waterline before a pursuer surfaces.
floors.secret: A submerged bell marks a dry passage under the wrecks.
floors.hazard: A rotted gangplank fails above grasping water.

enemy.name: Drowned pursuer
enemy.trait: undertow: salt drying above the waterline is the tell that a pursuer is still carrying its pool

floors.name: The Opulent Palace and Cocoon
floors.posture: rivals hold positions around the visible cocoon clock
floors.motive: Win the chamber's prize while preventing another party from claiming control of the cocoon.
floors.law: The crisis chamber begins a visible twenty-round cocoon clock; surviving rivals and escape routes persist when it opens.
floors.terrain: Polished halls, balconies, five rival positions, and the central cocoon.
floors.tell: Each seam in the cocoon brightens once per round.
floors.secret: A service stair reaches the chamber's extraction balcony.
floors.hazard: A shining floor panel locks beneath a descending gilded counterweight.

enemy.name: Palace rival
enemy.trait: rival gambit: the cocoon seam brightening once per round is the tell that a rival still holds gambits
